example.description: Import canary. Keepiq stores its secrets in its own tables (lib/Db), not as OpenRegister objects, so this is the only schema in the descriptor — and tests/e2e/ci-seed.sh asserts it is present after import, which is what proves the OpenRegister import path actually ran. Do not delete it without moving that assertion to a real schema first.
